descriptions.d28d_worm_idle_fidget_8013a158: Plays a random idle fidget: with under 51200 bytes free, only the plain idle and far clips. Otherwise picks one of 7 fidgets, or occasionally one of 23 when enough memory is free, restarts the idle clip, plays three low-health clips when the worm has under 50 hit points, or else the picked clip, some with a speech line (HeadScratch, Wriggle, Brows, Flap, Nips, Periscope, Tash) through the service or the Yawn and Sneeze sounds.
